description: A React component for editing adhoc filters within a popover, supporting multiple tabs (simple and SQL), layer selection, and resize functionality.

classes.name: AdhocFilterEditPopover
classes.description: A React component class for editing adhoc filters with tabbed interface, layer selection, and resize capabilities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and loads layer options if applicable.

methods.name: onAdhocFilterChange
methods.description: Updates the component state with new adhoc filter.

methods.name: setSimpleTabIsValid
methods.description: Sets the validity state of the simple tab.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the current filter, updating layer scope if needed, and closing the popover.

methods.name: onDragDown
methods.description: Initiates resize operation by recording starting position and adding mousemove listener.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Updates width and height during resize based on mouse movement.

methods.name: onMouseUp
methods.description: Ends resize operation by removing mousemove listener.

methods.name: adjustHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the popover.

methods.name: loadLayerOptions
methods.description: Fetches layer options from API with pagination.

methods.name: onLayerChange
methods.description: Updates selected layers and filter scope.
